verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਮੇਘ ਬਰਖਤ ਹਰਖਤਿ ਹੈ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਾਨ ਬਿਲਖ ਬਦਨ ਲੋਧਾ ਲੋਨ ਗਰਿ ਜਾਤਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise megh barakhat harakhat hai kirasaan bilakh badhan lodhaa lon gar jaat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a farmer is delighted to see the rainfall but the face of a weaver becomes ashen and he feels restless and miserable.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਰਫੁਲਿਤ ਹੁਇ ਸਕਲ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਸੁਕਤ ਜਵਾਸੋ ਆਕ ਮੂਲ ਮੁਰਝਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise parafulit hui sakal banaasapatee sukat javaaso aak mool murajhaat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as all the vegetation turns green with the fall of rain but the plant of camel thorn (Alhagi maurorum) withers while akk (Calotropis procera) dries out right from its roots.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਖੇਤ ਸਰਵਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਿਰਖ ਜਲ ਊਚ ਥਲ ਕਾਲਰ ਨ ਜਲ ਠਹਿਰਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise khet saravar pooran kirakh jal uooch thal kaalar na jal Thahiraat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as ponds and fields are filled with water when it rains, but no water can accumulate on mounds and saline land.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਪਰਵੇਸ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਾਕਤ ਸਕਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਸਕੁਚਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੫੧੮॥
verses.translit_en: gur upadhes paraves gursikh ridhai saakat sakat man sun sakuchaat hai ||518||

en.bdb: Similarly, the sermon of the True Guru permeates in the mind of a Sikh. But a self-oriented person who is in the grip of the worldly attractions, remains cringed hearing the divine words of the Guru. (518)
